# What branch `windows` adds to upstream `main`

<!-- Generated by scripts/windows/New-TruUpstreamDiff.ps1 - do not edit here: notes in docs/data/upstream_diff_notes.tsv, sections 2-3 in docs/data/upstream_diff_curated.md -->

This page lists only what this fork has that the original project's `main` does not, for anyone who wants to pick something up. Base: upstream `main` at the merge base `7761890` (2026-11-04); this branch at `e33bdcc` (2026-11-06). Dates and history: [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md).

## 2. Converter fault families fixed as pipeline steps

Each family was found through a crash dump or a test in game, proven on the Xbox / PC base pairs before it became a
rule, and has a check that reports affected files. They come from the shared converter, so other builds of the DLC may
show them too. Numbers: [WINDOWS_REBUILD.md](WINDOWS_REBUILD.md).

| Fault | Effect in game | Fix / check | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|
| SoundPlex sequence nodes (type 10): repeat byte at data +0xc swapped as a u32 (Xbox `01 00 00 00`, PC `00 00 00 01`) | repeat 0 = endless: doppelganger vocals loop until death | `tools/soundplex_sequence_fix.py scan <mods>` (step `seqrepeat` in `tools/dlc_struct_fixes.py`) | 49 |
| Object-data texture group counts left raw (`0x04000000` instead of 4) | the engine masks megabytes with 0x1fff, crash at tru+0x12b4a0 (`dlc_fx_cine_thrall_death` from pack11, `dlc_fx_goo_machine_column_core`) | `tools/objdata_texlist_check.py`, `tools/objdata_fx_fix.py` (steps `objtex` / `objrec`) | 47 |
| Particle record byte / u16 fields swapped as u32 | crash tru+0x42e62 (goo drips), wrong effects | `tools/objdata_fx_fix.py` (step `objrec`) | 47 |
| DLC 2 thrall base script re-authored under the main-game id 12433 with another instance layout | crash when thralls are unloaded | `tools/script_clash_fix.py`, scan `tools/script_layout_clash.py` | 45, 46 |
| Player breath-sound section ids as two u16 instead of one translated u32 | invalid ids (`0x04890000`, `0x68f40000`) | step `objid` in `tools/dlc_struct_fixes.py` | 48 |
| State-VM code words, event / effect-node ids, state-chart id parameters, anim / object event lists | heap corruption after the wall run, crashes near thralls | `tools/converter_faults_fix.py` (`statevm`, `idword`, `fxnode`, `chartid`, `animlist`, `objevent`) | 44 |
| Cloth iteration count as two s16 halves (4 -> 262 144 passes per frame) | DLC 2 intro in slow motion | step `cloth` in `tools/dlc_fixes_build.py` | 43 |
| UI timeline target paths and UI text string ids converted as Symbols | crash after the DLC 2 intro, empty hint box | `tools/script_u16array_fix.py`, `tools/script_uitext_fix.py` (steps `uipath` / `uitext`) | 43 |
| Pixel shaders reading two different constant registers in one instruction (272 in B138) | "A problem has occurred with your display driver" on a real GPU | `tools/shader_const_fix.py` | 43 |
| `.mul` IMA encoding that ignores the decoder's step cap (8191) | crackling sibilants, clicks on loud transients | game-model encoder in `tools/mul_audio_nch.py`, measure with `tools/listen_game_model.py` | 18 |
| NavPower NavGraph image (Level+0x60) swapped like a DTP; it is little-endian on the Xbox too, only the count word after resource 1 is in platform order | navmesh areas off (292 of 600 areas in `dlc_yggdrasil_end`) | `tools/navgraph_raw_fix.py scan <mods>` (step `navraw`) | 50 |

### The same checks on the B270 kit files

The B270 kit was rebuilt offline from its patches (`tools/kit_rebuild.py`, 484 of 484 files) and run through the
checks above; nothing from the kit was executed. Read-only, for whoever maintains these files:

| Check | B270 kit files | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Pixel shaders with two constant registers in one instruction (`tools/shader_const_fix.py`) | 500 distinct shaders, 1 500 instructions in 55 files | B138: 272 |
| Thrall base class re-authored under 12433 (`tools/script_layout_clash.py`) | 86 classes overlap | crash when thralls are unloaded (findings 45, 46) |
| Calls into the title update's `achievement` natives (script 66) | 11 references | with the retail PC exe such a call reads address `0x0000000c` (descriptor 0) at tru+0x17de64 / tru+0x1766f0; not checked against the B270 exe patch |
| Raw ids (`tools/converter_faults_fix.py`) | `idword` 4, `fxnode` 4, `chartid` 1, `animlist` 1 | thrall event ids, effect nodes |
| Particle record words (`objrec`) | 8 (raft bridge) | finding 47 |
| DTP byte order in the 22 DLC 1 files changed after B138 | all changed words confirmed by base pairs | one more word with the same rule: water wheel `+0xbc4` |
| SoundPlex sequence repeat, texture group counts, breath-sound ids, cloth count, UI paths | 0 | – |
| NavGraph images (`tools/navgraph_raw_fix.py scan`) | 0 in 22 units | raw, as on the Xbox |

## 3. Names not listed in the B270 manifest

Four DLC records have no entry in `docs/data/B270_acqua.kit_manifest.json` (nor in B269 / B138, searched by source hash
and target path with `tools/kit_manifest_names.py`), so the kits probably do not install them. Every name is
hash-checked (`tools/name_hash_check.py <name>`) and now listed in `docs/data/dlc_names_extra.txt`, which
`tools/dlc_names.py` reads (it refuses a line whose hash does not match).

| Hash | Name | What it is / where the name comes from |
|---|---|---|
| `0x753ecefd` (pack10 and pack11, identical) | `xenon-w\image\loading_bg_dlc1.raw` | DLC 1 loading-screen background, 640x360 A8R8G8B8 (= `dlc_level1_preview` without the white frame); named by the title-update loading-screen script (generalbank script 8:6) next to the base `loading_bg_*` |
| `0xae29666a` (pack11) | `xenon-w\image\loading_bg_dlc2.raw` | DLC 2 loading-screen background, 1280x720, same script |
| `0xc986dd53` (pack11) | `xenon-w\audio\streams\event_triggered\reveals\dlc2_machine_room_second_bridge_reveal.mul` | named in `dlc2_goo_room` (script 8:26727); upstream's own `tools/dlc_names3.py` (round 3) finds it |
| `0xc2492c8b` (pack11) | `xenon-w\audio\streams\music\l7_valhalla_2\entering_hellheim(1).mul` | named in `dlc2_goo_room` (script 8:26727); round 3 misses it (the `(1)` does not fit its pattern) |

## 4. New parts

- **Plugins (ASI, loaded by ModLoader)** (11): [`TruDataGuard`](../src/asi/TruDataGuard/), [`TruDlc2Player`](../src/asi/TruDlc2Player/), [`TruDoppelganger`](../src/asi/TruDoppelganger/), [`TruGuard`](../src/asi/TruGuard/), [`TruLink`](../src/asi/TruLink/), [`TruMenu`](../src/asi/TruMenu/), [`TruRockVein`](../src/asi/TruRockVein/), [`TruShadowCombat`](../src/asi/TruShadowCombat/), [`TruShadowHud`](../src/asi/TruShadowHud/), [`TruShadowPower`](../src/asi/TruShadowPower/), [`TruTrace`](../src/asi/TruTrace/). The title update's exe code (shadow power, combat, rock veins, DLC 2 player) translated into small add-ons, plus test helpers; each has its own README.
- **Windows scripts** (26) in [scripts/windows/](../scripts/windows/README.md):
  - `Build-TruAsi.ps1` - Builds the ASI plugins of this fork (src\asi\<name>\<name>.cpp) with the installed Visual Studio x86 toolchain.
  - `Connect-TruDevChannel.ps1` - Read-only client for the TCP server inside tru.exe on port 9264 - the FMOD Ex profiler server (audio telemetry).
  - `Get-Tools.ps1` - Downloads the portable tools (Ghidra, Temurin JDK 25, Xenia Canary, Yura, ffmpeg, TRAWindowed) into <workspace>\bin and verifies SHA-256.
  - `Get-TruTreeStack.ps1` - Read-only report of the stacked tree installs (backup\tree_*): what each open install wrote, which install "owns" each changed mods file now, whether every -Restore would pass its checks, and what the mods files would be after undoing the open installs.
  - `Install-TruDlc.ps1` - Installs the trudlcport (Xbox 360 DLC -> PC) build and ModLoader into the Steam copy of Tomb Raider: Underworld.
  - `Install-TruModFile.ps1` - Replaces one file in the game's mods\ folder with a new build (with backup), or restores the backup.
  - `Install-TruTree.ps1` - Lays a converted mods tree (e.g. the DLC 2 test tree) over the game's mods\ folder, with backup and exact undo.
  - `Invoke-TruLink.ps1` - Client for TruLink.asi - the live read / write channel into the running tru.exe (127.0.0.1, default port 9265).
  - `Invoke-TruPipeline.ps1` - Runs one stage of the trudlcport conversion pipeline (Python tools in the clone) with full logging.
  - `Invoke-TruTestRun.ps1` - One regression run of the game: installs the state of a test profile, starts the game (optionally under cdb), preloads the TO TEST list over TruLink, waits for the game to end and collects logs, markers and test states.
  - `Measure-TruProcessMemory.ps1` - Samples the memory of running Python processes (read-only) to size parallel pipeline runs.
  - `New-TruUpstreamDiff.ps1` - Writes docs/UPSTREAM_DIFF.md: what this branch has that upstream main does not (changed upstream files with the reason, converter fault families, names, new parts).
  - `Set-TruDataGuard.ps1` - Installs or removes TruDataGuard.asi (invalid section ids -> logged "not found" instead of a crash) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruDisplay.ps1` - Switches Tomb Raider: Underworld between windowed and fullscreen mode (TRAWindowed + registry, current user).
  - `Set-TruDlc2Player.ps1` - Installs or removes TruDlc2Player.asi (DLC 2 player: doppelganger as player object, type record, DoppelgangerInit) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruDoppelganger.ps1` - Installs or removes TruDoppelganger.asi (DLC 2 player: title-update state-machine ids) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruGuard.ps1` - Installs or removes TruGuard.asi (exception diagnostics: fault sites, minidumps, optional resume) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruLink.ps1` - Installs or removes TruLink.asi (live read / write channel on 127.0.0.1, default port 9265) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruMenu.ps1` - Installs or removes TruMenu.asi (in-game debug menu, Dear ImGui, L3 + R3) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruRockVein.ps1` - Installs or removes TruRockVein.asi (DLC 2 rock veins: title-update markup conditions 607 / 608) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruShadowCombat.ps1` - Installs or removes TruShadowCombat.asi (DLC 2 combat: the title update's target list, target conditions and shadow-strike gate) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruShadowHud.ps1` - Installs or removes TruShadowHud.asi (DLC 2 shadow meter HUD: the title update's larabase natives f70-f73 and dlc2data f0) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruShadowPower.ps1` - Installs or removes TruShadowPower.asi (DLC 2 shadow-power slow motion) next to tru.exe.
  - `Set-TruTrace.ps1` - Installs or removes TruTrace.asi (log-only diagnostics: sound start / end, teleport + chart state, 0x1f4 / 0x1f5 receivers, spawn requests, object 858, TimeVector) next to tru.exe.
  - `Test-TruPreflight.ps1` - Read-only check before a test evening: game folder, stacked trees, generalbank, the ASI / INI state a run profile expects, cdb, disk, RAM, save folder and a few registry settings.
  - `Test-TruUploadReady.ps1` - Checks our commits in this repository for things that must not be published (read-only).
- **Test profiles** (84 files) in `tests/`: what a test run installs and checks (`Invoke-TruTestRun.ps1`).
- **Docs** (9): [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md), [COSTUMES.md](COSTUMES.md), [DLC_MENU.md](DLC_MENU.md), [DLC2.md](DLC2.md), [Regression-DLC1.md](Regression-DLC1.md), [Regression-DLC2.md](Regression-DLC2.md), [RELATED_WORK.md](RELATED_WORK.md), [WINDOWS_REBUILD.md](WINDOWS_REBUILD.md), [WS_MAP.md](WS_MAP.md)
